Intro

Who to Pray to, Pragmatic Prayers

Presented here are 3 rationales that may lead to the highest possibility of having your prayers answered.

Each rationale with different premises all turn out to lead to the same conclusion as to how best to have your prayers answered or be better protected from unlucky harm such as a car accident or victim of random crime.
